text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that a play was being held for a school event,
I stopped by... only to find a student in flashy attire
frantically bowing in apology.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
They asked us to sub in for some kids who couldn't make it!
Alrighty~ I'm gonna captivate the whole audience
with my acting!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold on. We can't stand out too much.
You're "Retainer A" and I'm "Maidservant B."
We're just backup background extras, remember.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so the play commenced, progressing smoothly.
...However, right as the story
reached its climax—

text_block_list.name: Villain Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Bwahahaha! With this,
everything is mine! The treasure, the princess, the kingdom,
the legendary sword... and the real estate assets too!

text_block_list.name: Protagonist Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
I-I won't let you get away with this!
For I am—

text_block_list.name: Lead Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
"...B-Because, I...! 
...H-Huh? U-Um...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps overwhelmed by nerves, she seemed to have forgotten her lines.
A murmur of confusion spread through the audience, who had been watching the scene with bated breath—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...! Because! 
There is no need to trouble my master! 
For I, Teio the retainer—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"—shall bring evil villains like you to justice! 
Yaaah! Ultimate Teio Rolling Attaaack!"

text_block_list.name: Villain Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: "Eh... G-Gwaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"What were those moves just now... Isn't she like a real action star!? 
So cool! Awesome!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Now, prepare yourself, villain! 
Next up is my Teio Hurricane into 
Teio Plasma Buster!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With that, Tokai Teio showed off one brilliant action move after another... and it completely turned into her own one-woman show!

text_block_list.name: Lead Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
"A-Ahaha... T-Truly magnificent, my retainer! 
B-But, um... it's about time, uh..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, my Lord! 
How boundless is your mercy...!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Though they are an enemy, they must have had deep reasons to fall so low... Thinking of that, you could not bring yourself to strike them down with your own hands!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"And that is why... Teio. 
You understood our Lord's heart, 
and brought down the hammer of justice in their stead, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...! 
Indeed it is! Please, leave such painful duties to your faithful retainer!"

text_block_list.name: Lead Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
"A-Ah! I gave you a bitter task— 
Yet evil has now been vanquished. 
Come, let us return home—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the play's story somehow managed to get back on track... closing the curtain amidst roaring applause.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"—Everyone, I'm sorry! 
I thought I had to get things back on track, but halfway through, I got totally carried away...!"

text_block_list.name: Lead Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, not at all! 
If it weren't for you, Teio-san, things would've completely fallen apart halfway through...!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Yeah, yeah. My ad-lib came totally out of nowhere too, but you adapted to it right away."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...No, Nature's the amazing one. 
You stayed in character, supported the lead... and saved the entire play itself."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "...I might've gotten all the cheers, but the truly cool one was you, Nature. That's what I think!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Right, right. Someone like me can back others up, but there's no way I could hype up a crowd like that."

text_block_list.name: Villain Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
"More importantly, look, it's curtain call time! 
Let's go, everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"! All right, then for the finale, 
I'll do my super special action move—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"—Wait, no, no! 
I have to let the lead take the spotlight!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The coolness of quietly supporting others from behind the scenes. 
Having learned that, Tokai Teio looked somehow a little more grown-up.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "! All right, I'll show off my super special action move for the finale!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, hold on! 
You're still rushing right out to the front after all that!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even if she realized a new form of "coolness," it seemed it would still be a while before she actually put it into practice...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Mature...! All right, it's decided! 
I'm gonna master that kind of cool, too!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "To start off... until the event ends, I'll go help out all over the place!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Today, Lady Teio is a shadow helper hero! 
That's the plan!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The coolness of quietly supporting others from behind the scenes. 
Having learned that, Tokai Teio looked somehow a little more grown-up.
